items.title: Tech stocks rally as oil prices fall, inflation remains sticky: AlphaCheck
items.summary: Here's a check of the markets in the first few minutes of trading.

items.title: Stock Market Today: Dow Rallies On Surprise Inflation Data; These Tech Names Lead This List (Live Coverage)
items.summary: Stock Market Today: The Dow Jones index rallies Friday after a surprise CPI inflation report. Nvidia stock rebounded in morning trading.

items.title: Adobe Just Fell Off Another Cliff: Why One Wall Street Manager Remains Resolute That It Will Increase 55% Soon
items.summary: Adobe keeps beating earnings and raising guidance, yet its stock has collapsed nearly 29% this year while one analyst holds a price target that implies a 55% surge. Something in the market's reaction does not add up, and the answer reveals a high-stakes bet on whether Adobe's AI strategy is a trap or a springboard.

items.title: Stocks to Watch Friday: Oracle, Adobe, RH
items.summary: ↗️ Oracle (ORCL): Shares in the database and cloud-computing company gained less than 1% in morning trading after it reported sharply higher quarterly profit and revenue. Sales from Oracle’s cloud-infrastructure business more than doubled.

items.title: Oracle, Micron, Kroger, Adobe, Hewlett Packard, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: Shares of Oracle rise after the software giant’s first-quarter results help ease some concerns about its reliance on OpenAI.

items.title: Adobe Q3 Earnings Call Centers on Agentic AI and Freemium
items.summary: Adobe is betting on agentic AI and freemium growth, prioritizing user adoption as AI-first ARR surges and management raises its fiscal 2026 outlook.

items.title: Adobe Pulls Back, Then Recovers as CEO Handoff Meets Soft Q4 Outlook; Intuit and ServiceNow Hold Steady
items.summary: Adobe beat estimates and raised its full-year outlook, yet the stock still stumbled out of the gate Friday morning. A soft Q4 guide and a simultaneous CEO and CFO transition are now weighing on a franchise already down 30% for the year.

items.summary: Record Q3 results and AI-driven ARR growth fuel guidance raise.
